# Overview

Here we want to investigate the overlap (consistency) of peaks and motif instances across clusters. For example, when
we see a set of CTCF sites in one cell type vs another, how much of those sites are
common vs cell type specific? Do positive and negative motifs exhibit different patterns?

# Set up

```{r libs, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = TRUE, cache = FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(scales)
library(glue)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(plotly)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)

script_path <- here("code/utils/")
source(file.path(script_path, "plotting_config.R"))
source(file.path(script_path, "hdma_palettes.R"))
source(file.path(script_path, "sj_scRNAseq_helpers.R"))

ggplot2::theme_set(theme_BOR())

```



# Load data

Cluster and motif metadata:

```{r load_cluster_meta}

load(here("output/03-chrombpnet/03-syntax/01/intermediate_obj.Rda"))

cluster_order <- cluster_meta$Cluster_ChromBPNet[cluster_meta$Cluster_ChromBPNet %in% chrombpnet_models_keep$Cluster]
length(cluster_order)

organ_map <- cluster_meta %>% distinct(organ, organ_code)
cmap_cluster <- cluster_meta %>% dplyr::select(Cluster_ChromBPNet, organ_color) %>% tibble::deframe()
cluster_anno <- cluster_meta %>% 
  dplyr::select(Organ = organ, Compartment = compartment, Cluster_ChromBPNet) %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Cluster_ChromBPNet")

```



# Overlap in peaks

```{r}

jaccard_peaks <- map_dfr(names(cmap_peaktype),
                         ~ data.table::fread(
                           here(glue("{out}/jaccard_results.{.x}.txt")), data.table = FALSE) %>% 
                           mutate(cluster_A = gsub(glue("peaks.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_A),
                                  cluster_B = gsub(glue("peaks.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_B),
                                  clusters = paste0(cluster_A, " - ", cluster_B),
                                  region = .x))

# this fills out the full heatmap, since we only calculated the upper triangle
jaccard_peaks_all_pairwise <- bind_rows(
  jaccard_peaks,
  jaccard_peaks %>% filter(cluster_A != cluster_B) %>% mutate(cluster_tmp = cluster_A) %>% dplyr::select(-cluster_A) %>% dplyr::rename(cluster_A = cluster_B, cluster_B = cluster_tmp)
)

# look at the top ones
jaccard_peaks %>%
  filter(cluster_A != cluster_B) %>%
  group_by(region) %>% 
  slice_max(n = 1, order_by = jaccard_index) %>% 
  dplyr::select(cluster_A, cluster_B, region, jaccard_index)

jaccard_peaks %>% 
  group_by(region) %>% 
  summarize(median = median(jaccard_index))

```


```{r jaccard_peaks, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 4}

cardiomyocytes <- cluster_meta %>% filter(L3_annot == "cardiomyocytes") %>% pull(Cluster_ChromBPNet)

jaccard_peaks_cm <- jaccard_peaks %>% 
  filter(cluster_A %in% cardiomyocytes & cluster_B %in% cardiomyocytes) %>% 
  filter(jaccard_index != 0) %>% 
  filter(cluster_A != cluster_B)

jaccard_peaks %>% 
  # filter out self-self calculations, and 0, which typically 
  # represents a lack of hits for the given motif in that cell type
  filter(jaccard_index != 0) %>% 
  filter(cluster_A != cluster_B) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = region, y = jaccard_index)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = region), outliers = FALSE, fill = "gray80") +
  geom_point(data = jaccard_peaks_cm, alpha = 0.3, size = 3, color = "red") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cmap_peaktype) +
  xlab("Motif") + ylab("Jaccard index (peak overlap)") +
  ggtitle("Pairwise peak overlap by region type") +
  ylim(c(0, 1))

```


## Heatmaps {.tabset}

```{r}

heatmap_fun <- purrr::partial(
  pheatmap,
  border_color = NA,
  color = ylrd,
  annotation_col = cluster_anno,
  annotation_row = cluster_anno,
  cellwidth = 4,
  cellheight = 4,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_colors = list("Organ" = cmap_organ,
                           "Compartment" = cmap_compartment2))

plot_peak_heatmaps <- function(key, cluster = TRUE) {
  
  jaccard_peaks_mat <- jaccard_peaks_all_pairwise %>% 
    filter(region == key) %>% 
    dplyr::select(cluster_A, cluster_B, jaccard_index) %>% 
    spread(cluster_B, jaccard_index) %>% 
    tibble::column_to_rownames("cluster_A") %>% 
    as.matrix()
  
  if (cluster) {
    
    heatmap_fun(mat = jaccard_peaks_mat[cluster_order, cluster_order],
                main = "Promoter similarity",
                filename = glue("{figout}/heatmap.{key}.cluster.png"))
    
    knitr::include_graphics(glue("{figout}/heatmap.{key}.cluster.png"))
    
  } else {
    
    heatmap_fun(mat = jaccard_peaks_mat[cluster_order, cluster_order],
                cluster_rows = FALSE,
                cluster_cols = FALSE,
                main = "Promoter similarity",
                filename = glue("{figout}/heatmap.{key}.dend_order.png"))
    
    knitr::include_graphics(glue("{figout}/heatmap.{key}.dend_order.png"))
    
  }
  
}

```


### Promoter

```{r}

plot_peak_heatmaps("Promoter")
plot_peak_heatmaps("Promoter", cluster = TRUE)

```

### Distal

```{r}

plot_peak_heatmaps("Distal")
plot_peak_heatmaps("Distal", cluster = TRUE)

```

# Overlap in hits for individual motifs

```{r overlap_hits, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 4}

jaccard_pos <- map_dfr(c("CTCF", "NFY", "YY1"),
                       ~ data.table::fread(
                         here(glue("{out}/jaccard_results.{.x}.pos_patterns.txt")), data.table = FALSE) %>% 
                         mutate(cluster_A = gsub(glue("hits.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_A),
                                cluster_B = gsub(glue("hits.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_B),
                                motif = .x,
                                class = "pos_patterns"))

jaccard_neg <- map_dfr(c("NFY", "YY1", "ZEB", "HIC"),
                       ~ data.table::fread(
                         here(glue("{out}/jaccard_results.{.x}.neg_patterns.txt")), data.table = FALSE) %>% 
                         mutate(cluster_A = gsub(glue("hits.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_A),
                                cluster_B = gsub(glue("hits.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_B),
                                motif = .x,
                                class = "neg_patterns"))

jaccard_pos_neg <- bind_rows(jaccard_neg, jaccard_pos) %>% 
  # filter out self-self calculations, and 0, which typically 
  # represents a lack of hits for the given motif in that cell type
  filter(jaccard_index != 0) %>% 
  filter(cluster_A != cluster_B) %>% 
  mutate(class = ifelse(class == "pos_patterns", "positive", "negative"))

jaccard_pos_neg_cm <- jaccard_pos_neg %>% 
  filter(cluster_A %in% cardiomyocytes & cluster_B %in% cardiomyocytes)

jaccard_pos_neg %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = class, y = jaccard_index)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = motif), outliers = FALSE, fill = "gray80") +
  geom_point(data = jaccard_pos_neg_cm, alpha = 0.3, size = 3, color = "red") +
  facet_grid(. ~ motif, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  xlab("Motif") + ylab("Jaccard index (instance overlap)") +
  ggtitle("Pairwise motif instance overlap") +
  ylim(c(0, 1))

```




# Switching direction for dual motifs

```{r}

jaccard_dual_switch <- map_dfr(c("NFY", "YY1"),
                         ~ data.table::fread(
                           here(glue("{out}/jaccard_results.{.x}_switch.txt")), data.table = FALSE) %>% 
                           mutate(cluster_A = gsub(glue("hits.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_A),
                                  cluster_B = gsub(glue("hits.{.x}.|.bed"), "", cluster_B),
                                  clusters = paste0(cluster_A, " -> ", cluster_B),
                                  motif = .x))

```


```{r jaccard_switch_dual, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 4}

jaccard_dual_cm <- jaccard_dual_switch %>% 
  filter(cluster_A %in% cardiomyocytes & cluster_B %in% cardiomyocytes)

jaccard_dual_switch %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = motif, y = jaccard_index)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = motif), outlier.alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = 21, fill = "gray80") +
  geom_point(data = jaccard_dual_cm, alpha = 0.3, size = 3, color = "red") +
  xlab("Motif") + ylab("Jaccard index (switching of the same sequence)") +
  ggtitle("Pairwise hit overlap for dual motifs") +
  ylim(c(0, 1))

jaccard_dual_switch %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = motif, y = jaccard_index)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = motif), outlier.alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = 21, fill = "gray80") +
  geom_point(data = jaccard_dual_cm, alpha = 0.3, size = 3, color = "red") +
  xlab("Motif") + ylab("Jaccard index (switching of the same sequence)") +
  ggtitle("Pairwise hit overlap for dual motifs")

```
